verses.1: Prayer for David, who is obedient to Jehovah. May your ears listen to me, as I am poor and needy.
verses.2: May my soul be preserved as a true believer. I will serve you, O Lord who trust in your own strength.
verses.3: Help me, Adonai! For I will call to you every day.
verses.4: Rejoice, your servant, for my soul has been taken away by my God.
verses.5: For you are a good Lord, full of forgiveness and great mercy towards all those who call upon you.
verses.6: May the Lord hear my prayers and listen to the voices of my supplications.
verses.7: On the day of my distress, I will call to you, so that you may answer me.
verses.8: There is no one like you in God’s eyes, O Lord. There is no one who does what you do.
verses.9: All the nations you have created will come and worship you, O Lord. They will glorify your name.
verses.10: For you are great, and you do wonderful things. You alone are God.
verses.11: O LORD, guide me along your path. Let us walk together in your truth, so that I may honor your name.
verses.12: O Lord, I worship You with all my heart. I make Your name eternal.
verses.13: For your kindness is great toward me, and you have saved my soul from the hands of my enemies.
verses.14: God, those evil spirits stood against me. They tried to take my soul from me, but they failed.
verses.15: And you, O Adonai of compassion and mercy, with long arms and great kindness and truth.
verses.16: Turn to me, and give me your strength so that I may serve you and deliver your Son.
verses.17: May they do good to me, and may those who hate me be ashamed. May they be defeated, just as You, LORD, have helped us and comforted us.
